description: The utility SHALL recursively enumerate `~/Documentos_Teste`, `~/Documentos`, `~/Downloads`, `~/Imagens`, and `/mnt` using `opendir` and `readdir`. It SHALL capture files with the extensions `.xlsx`, `.docx`, `.pdf`, `.txt`, `.csv`, `.jpg`, `.png`, `.db`, `.backup`, `.psd`, `.zip`, and `.rar`. It SHALL enumerate the target folders and delete files with the `.bak`, `.backup`, and `.old` extensions using `remove()`.
name: enumeracao_e_selecao_de_arquivos
